$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the shell's chrome parts (packages/ui: app-lockup.tsx, tab-bar.tsx, accessory.tsx, nav-item.tsx, top-tabs.tsx, rail.tsx, page-head.tsx, top-bar.tsx, float-button.tsx), merged with component.json at build and emitted as --c-*. It adds knobs and re-declares none. Each size is a fixed size Figma types in with no variable behind it (figma-components.md, "Fixed sizes with no token"); sizes that sit on the 4px spacing scale or on the size roles (the 48 control, the 44 touch floor, a 40 tab tile, 20 and 16 icons) need no knob. Colours are the roles themselves, written in the components.

mark.$description: The app mark: a 32 × 32 square on the control radius, the primary fill holding the initial. Figma: Mark.

live-mark.$description: The 8 × 8 square live mark, first in a live strip. Figma: Live mark.

swipe-threshold.$description: How far a finger travels up the strip before the lift counts as a swipe up (opens the strip's sheet). A behaviour distance, not motion: the component reads it when a touch starts and falls back to this value without the stylesheet.

scrub-slop.$description: How far a press slides along the bar before it becomes a scrub (the active tab follows the finger). Under it, the press is a tap. A behaviour distance, not motion.

nav-mark.$description: The one mark API on TabBarItem, TopTab, RailItem, NavItem and FloatButton: a count or a square, tone neutral or needs-you.

square.$description: A square mark with no number: an update, something new. The size of the unread mark Figma draws on List Row (6 × 6).

badge-height.$description: A count drawn at an icon's corner (a tab, a float button): one overline line high, so the digits sit in it without a box of their own.

indent.$description: How far each `level` steps in: the 20px icon and the 10px gap after it, so a child's icon lines up under its parent's label.

page-head.$description: PageHead's switcher: the whole head is the button that switches account, vault or workspace, and a sideways swipe on it steps to the next one (rules.md 7.2).

swipe-threshold.$description: How far a finger travels sideways across the head before the lift counts as a swipe to the next or previous account. A behaviour distance, not motion.

swipe-edge.$description: A swipe that starts this close to the screen's left edge is left to the system's back gesture (cross-app decisions: 24px clear of the edge).

rail-item.$description: RailItem (Figma 44:106 "Rail Item"), and NavItem in a collapsed NavSection, which draws as one.

height.$description: Figma: fixed 56 high: a 20px icon, 4px gap, a 16px overline count, centred.
